text_en: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
text_cn: 当羔羊开启了第七个印的时候，天上静默了约半小时。

text_en: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
text_cn: 然后，我看见那站在天主面前的七位天使；给了他们七个号角。

text_en: Another angel with a golden censer came and stood at the altar; he was given a great quantity of incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar that is before the throne.
text_cn: 又来了另一位天使，持着金香炉，站在祭坛旁；给了他许多乳香，为同众圣徒的祈祷，一起献在宝座前的金坛上。

text_en: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel.
text_cn: 乳香的烟与圣徒的祈祷，遂由那位天使的手中，升到天主面前。

text_en: Then the angel took the censer and filled it with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth; and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
text_cn: 此后，那位天使提起香炉，盛满了祭坛上的火，抛到地上，遂发生了雷霆、响声、闪电和地动。

text_en: Now the seven angels who had the seven trumpets made ready to blow them.
text_cn: 以后，那七位持着七个号角的天使，就准备着吹号角。

text_en: The first angel blew his trumpet, and there came hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were hurled to the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
text_cn: 第一位一吹号角，就有搀着血的冰雹和火抛到地上；于是大地被烧毁了三分之一，树木也被烧毁了三分之一，青草全被烧尽。

text_en: The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain, burning with fire, was thrown into the sea.
text_cn: 第二位天使一吹号角，就好像有一座燃着的火的大山，投入海中；于是海的三分之一便成了血，

text_en: A third of the sea became blood, a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
text_cn: 海里一切有生命之物也死了三分之一，船只也毁坏了三分之一。

text_en: The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, blazing like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
text_cn: 第三位天使一吹号角，就有一颗大星，炽燃有如火把，从天上落下来，落在河的三分之一和水泉上。

text_en: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many died from the water, because it was made bitter.
text_cn: 这星的名字叫“苦艾”；于是水的三分之一变成苦的，许多人因水变苦了而死去。

text_en: The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of their light was darkened; a third of the day was kept from shining, and likewise the night.
text_cn: 第四位天使一吹号角，太阳的三分之一，月亮的三分之一和星辰的三分之一，都受了打击，以致它们的三分之一黑暗了，白日三分之一失了光，黑夜也是一样。

text_en: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew in midheaven, “Woe, woe, woe to the inhabitants of the earth, at the blasts of the other trumpets that the three angels are about to blow! ”
text_cn: 以后，我看见，也听见在天空中飞翔的一只鹰大声说：“还有另三位吹号角的天使，当他们发出号声时，祸哉！祸哉！祸哉，地上的居民！”
